question: Where’s the closest museum along the travel direction toward Extended Stay America - Tacoma/Fife, Fife, WA?
sql: WITH destination AS ( SELECT geometry AS dest_geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Extended Stay America - Tacoma/Fife%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Fife%' LIMIT 1 ), fife_region AS ( SELECT geometry AS fife_geom FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Fife%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1 ), travel_vector AS ( SELECT ST_Centroid(fife_region.fife_geom) AS start_point, destination.dest_geom AS end_point, degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(fife_region.fife_geom), destination.dest_geom)) AS bearing FROM destination, fife_region ) SELECT p.poi_name FROM pois AS p, travel_vector AS tv WHERE p.tourism ILIKE '%museum%' -- Ensure the destination and a valid starting point (Fife centroid) were found AND tv.start_point IS NOT NULL AND tv.end_point IS NOT NULL -- Filter museums that are within a reasonable distance from the destination for performance AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, tv.end_point::geography, 50000) -- 50 km radius -- Filter museums that are in the general travel direction (within +/- 45 degrees of the bearing) AND ( LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(tv.start_point, p.geometry)) - tv.bearing), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(tv.start_point, p.geometry)) - tv.bearing) ) < 45 ) -- Ensure the museum is not past the destination relative to the starting point AND ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, tv.end_point::geography) < ST_Distance(tv.start_point::geography, tv.end_point::geography) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, tv.end_point::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
